definitions: A configuration object used in the SWR (Stale-While-Revalidate) data fetching library for React, defining global or per-hook settings for data caching, revalidation, and error handling.
examples: The SWRConfig provider wraps the application to set global defaults.
Each useSWR hook can override the SWRConfig settings.
Proper SWRConfig setup is crucial for optimal performance.
